title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Staying calm
hook: What does your voice sound like when you are frustrated?
intro: The same mistake happens for the fifth time.
You feel your voice getting louder.
statement: Kids hear the tone before the words.
q1: Do you pause and lower your voice —
q2: or let some frustration show so they know it matters?
q3: What do kids hear when you raise your voice?
t1: Every coach is different. But kids listen
cta: Coaches — how do you stay calm?
ctaLines: A breath. A water break. A quieter voice.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What does your voice sound like when you are frustrated?
The same mistake happens for the fifth time. You feel your voice getting louder.
Kids hear the tone before the words.
Stay calm or let some frustration show. Every team is different.
How do you stay calm? Share your habit in the comments.
